term: per se (essentially) ordered series of causes
definition: A series in which each cause after the first causes only insofar as it is, here and now, moved by the one before it: the stone is moved by the stick, the stick by the hand. In Lean the link is `MovesAsMoved y x` (y moves x only insofar as y is itself moved) and 'no infinite regress' is well-foundedness of that relation (`NoInfinitePerSeMoverSeriesReading`).
